title: VariantSpace
description: The variant dimensions a shape tree contributes, in declaration order (spec.md §6). This document is what the shape language hands to design 2.3: which dimensions exist, what points each has, and which points gate which dimensions. Selecting, sampling and naming whole variants is 2.3's business, not this document's.

dimensions.description: Every dimension in the tree, parents before the dimensions they gate.

id.description: '<path>#<facet>', stable across engine versions and pact-file round trips (spec.md §6.2).

path.description: The location of the operator that contributes the dimension, without the facet suffix.

facet.description: Which axis of the located value varies. Open vocabulary: a component operator may contribute its own.

operator.description: The shape operator that contributed the dimension.

points.description: The values this dimension can take. A dimension with fewer than two points is not a dimension (spec.md §6.1).

default.description: Name of the point the shape's own examples exercise — the base variant's assignment for this dimension.

gated-by.description: Points that must all be selected for this dimension to be active. Absent or empty means always active (spec.md §6.3).

name.description: Stable within the dimension: 'present'/'absent', 'null'/'non-null', an alternative name, a canonical literal rendering, or 'min'/'min+1'/'max'.

value.description: The literal this point selects, for 'value' facets.

size.description: The cardinality this point selects, for 'cardinality' facets.
